content.headline: Context Window: how much can AI read at once?
content.body: A bigger memory helps, but for 200-page policy documents, retrieval (RAG) still works better than pasting everything in.
bullets: 8K tokens → a short memo or one-page letter
128K tokens → a thick file, but AI may miss details in the middle
1–2M tokens → book-length, but still verify — never trust a blind paste
